_about: Public-domain Philander Chase (1775-1852), missionary bishop of Ohio and then of Illinois, founder of Kenyon College, for the Word Hoard: Bishop Chase's Reminiscences, an autobiography (Boston: James B. Dow, 1848, second edition, two volumes), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 40 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
